_about: Festival rules (never dates). masa = amanta month index (1 Chaitra .. 12 Phalguna); tithi 1..30 (16..30 Krishna). Day-assignment rules follow Dharmasindhu/Nirnayasindhu as digested in research/02 §1.10 and §2.6.8, and research/01 §3 for the 2026 anchors used in tests. North-Indian (purnimanta) names are given in `purnimantaName` where they differ.
